claim_text: Ecological information has regime-dependent predictive value for sparse water-quality reconstruction
fail_condition: No independent secondary missingness family or reproducible matched difference
non_claim_note: The heuristic regime grouping is descriptive; no causal or general missingness claim.

claim_text: A shared ecology-time representation transfers a source-observed target analyte to some held-out HUC6 basins
primary_scenario: DOC pH and specific conductance across five HUC6 leave-outs
non_claim_note: Bounded v1.1 control result; no confirmation or universal transfer claim.

claim_text: K=5 target support improves reconstruction relative to the source-only-selected simple baseline
fail_condition: Support shuffles are missing or K5 fails the >=10% gate
non_claim_note: Pooled pilot direction is positive; true-support specificity is now audited but basin-level harm remains.

claim_text: Transfer gains are present in at least three of five held-out HUC6 tasks
fail_condition: Fewer than three target HUC6 tasks improve
non_claim_note: Direction is present in all five tasks for each analyte, while local harm remains.

claim_text: True target support adds information beyond value and site shuffles
fail_condition: Either shuffle control is absent or true support does not beat both shuffles
non_claim_note: Value-shuffle evidence is broad but not uniform; site-shuffle is identifiable only on a density-dependent subset and is descriptive.

claim_text: K=5 is no worse than K=0 and K=1 for the primary aggregate
fail_condition: K5 is worse than K0 or K1
non_claim_note: This is a pooled pilot check and not confirmation evidence.

claim_text: No primary analyte/HUC6 cell worsens by more than 5% while pooled success is claimed
non_claim_note: DOC at target HUC6 102701 worsens by more than 5%; pooled success cannot erase this.

claim_text: Matched graph and no-ecology controls identify whether topology has incremental value
fail_condition: Matched differences are absent or inconsistent
non_claim_note: Graph and ecology comparisons are predictive controls; no topology contribution is claimed.

claim_text: Val-only empirical calibration changes coverage and interval width in analyte- and basin-dependent ways
fail_condition: Transfer uncertainty products cannot be recomputed
non_claim_note: Earlier DOC-only calibration remains separate Phase 3 evidence.

claim_text: Uncertainty ranking supports stable monitoring blind spots
fail_condition: Fewer than two independent tools or indicators pass
non_claim_note: Phase 3 R2 did not establish this claim; no blind-spot or active-sampling language.

claim_text: The direction replicates in an independently selected external basin
fail_condition: External direction fails or requires retuning
non_claim_note: External selection and evaluation remain future work.

claim_text: All target-HUC6 labels outside K support cells remain hidden during adaptation
fail_condition: Forbidden-label perturbation changes prediction or selection
non_claim_note: The runner loads complete arrays for mask checks but target query values are not consumed by fit or prediction; schema wording limitation is recorded.

claim_text: The source-observed target-analyte route has a legal native-unit K=0 output
fail_condition: Output scale uses target-HUC6 labels or unregistered target priors
non_claim_note: This does not extend to the blocked target-unseen-analyte K=0 route.

claim_text: The corrected Stage-2A same-analyte diagnostic is reproducible but does not establish cross-analyte transfer
fail_condition: Diagnostic is presented as held-out-analyte evidence
non_claim_note: Prior exposure is acknowledged and remains descriptive.

claim_text: The independent external case is not used for model selection or endpoint changes
fail_condition: External data influence tuning or endpoint choice
non_claim_note: External validation remains pending and unverified.
